public import transport = "./transport.qui"

string type_name(int kind)
    kinds := [1, 2, 5, 6, 12, 15, 16, 28]
    names := ["A", "NS", "CNAME", "SOA", "PTR", "MX", "TXT", "AAAA"]
    for: index < int(#kinds)
        if kinds[index] == kind
            return names[index]
    return "TYPE{kind}"

string rcode_name(int code)
    names := ["NoError", "FormErr", "ServFail", "NXDomain", "NotImp", "Refused"]
    return if code < int(#names) then names[code] else "RCODE{code}"

string label_text(int[] bytes)
    text := ""
    for byte := bytes[]
        text += if 33 <= byte <= 126 and byte != 46 and byte != 92 then transport.network.dump.ascii(byte) else "\{byte:03.}"
    return text

string ipv6(int[] data)
    int[] groups := []
    for: position < 16 step 2
        groups = groups.append(transport.network.integer(data, position, 2))
    best_start := -1
    best_length := 1
    index := 0
    while index < 8
        if groups[index] != 0
            index += 1
            continue
        end := index
        while end < 8 and groups[end] == 0
            end += 1
        if end - index > best_length
            best_start = index
            best_length = end - index
        index = end
    string[] texts := [for group := groups[] then transport.network.dump.hexadecimal(group, 1)]
    if best_start < 0
        return texts.join(":")
    return texts[0:<best_start].join(":") + "::" + texts[best_start + best_length:].join(":")

class Name(string text, int after)
class Rdata(string text, int after)

class Reader(int[] data)
    int[] | error chunk(int position, int size)
        if position + size > int(#data)
            return error("dns: truncated")
        return data[position:<position + size]

    int | error integer(int position, int size)
        int[] values := try chunk(position, size)
        return transport.network.integer(values, 0, size)

    Name | error name(int position)
        cursor := position
        string[] labels := []
        pointers := 0
        after := -1
        while true
            int size := try integer(cursor, 1)
            if size == 0
                if after < 0
                    after = cursor + 1
                break
            if size >= 192
                int low := try integer(cursor + 1, 1)
                if after < 0
                    after = cursor + 2
                pointers += 1
                if pointers > 16
                    return error("dns: compression loop")
                cursor = (size - 192) * 256 + low
                if cursor >= int(#data)
                    return error("dns: pointer out of range")
            elif size >= 64
                return error("dns: bad label type")
            else
                int[] label := try chunk(cursor + 1, size)
                labels = labels.append(label_text(label))
                cursor += size + 1
        return Name(if #labels == 0 then "<root>" else labels.join("."), after)

    Rdata | error rdata(int kind, int start, int size)
        if kind == 1
            int address := try integer(start, 4)
            return Rdata(transport.network.ipv4(address), start + 4)
        if kind == 28
            int[] address := try chunk(start, 16)
            return Rdata(ipv6(address), start + 16)
        if kind == 2 or kind == 5 or kind == 12
            Name value := try name(start)
            return Rdata(value.text, value.after)
        if kind == 15
            int preference := try integer(start, 2)
            Name exchange := try name(start + 2)
            return Rdata("{preference} {exchange.text}", exchange.after)
        if kind == 6
            Name primary := try name(start)
            Name mailbox := try name(primary.after)
            position := mailbox.after
            parts := [primary.text, mailbox.text]
            for _ < 5
                int value := try integer(position, 4)
                parts = parts.append("{value}")
                position += 4
            return Rdata(parts.join(" "), position)
        return Rdata("{size} bytes", start + size)

    int | error record(int position, string section, transport.network.Layer &layer)
        Name owner := try name(position)
        int[] fixed := try chunk(owner.after, 10)
        int kind := transport.network.integer(fixed, 0, 2)
        int class_number := transport.network.integer(fixed, 2, 2)
        int ttl := transport.network.integer(fixed, 4, 4)
        int size := transport.network.integer(fixed, 8, 2)
        start := owner.after + 10
        int[] checked := try chunk(start, size)
        Rdata body := try rdata(kind, start, size)
        if body.after != start + size
            return error("dns: bad rdata length")
        class_name := if class_number == 1 then "IN" else "CLASS{class_number}"
        .layer.fields.add_text(section, "{owner.text} " + type_name(kind) + " {class_name} {ttl} {body.text}")
        if section == "dns.answer"
            layer.answers = layer.answers.append(type_name(kind) + " " + body.text)
            if kind == 1
                .layer.fields.add_number("dns.a", transport.network.integer(data, start, 4))
        return start + size

transport.network.Layer | error dissect(int[] data)
    reader := Reader(data)
    header := try reader.chunk(0, 12)
    layer := transport.network.Layer()
    int flags := transport.network.integer(header, 2, 2)
    .layer.fields.put_number("dns.id", transport.network.integer(header, 0, 2))
    .layer.fields.put_number("dns.flags", flags)
    .layer.fields.put_number("dns.flags.response", flags / 32768 % 2)
    .layer.fields.put_number("dns.flags.opcode", flags / 2048 % 16)
    .layer.fields.put_number("dns.flags.rcode", flags % 16)
    names := ["queries", "answers", "auth_rr", "add_rr"]
    int[] counts := []
    for: index < 4
        int count := transport.network.integer(header, 4 + 2 * index, 2)
        counts = counts.append(count)
        .layer.fields.put_number("dns.count." + names[index], count)
    position := 12
    for _ < counts[0]
        query := try reader.name(position)
        tail := try reader.chunk(query.after, 4)
        .layer.fields.add_text("dns.qry.name", query.text)
        .layer.fields.add_number("dns.qry.type", transport.network.integer(tail, 0, 2))
        position = query.after + 4
    sections := ["dns.answer", "dns.authority", "dns.additional"]
    for: index < 3
        for _ < counts[index + 1]
            position = try reader.record(position, sections[index], &layer)
    return layer

public import dns = "./dns_app.qui"


int sequence_limit()
    return 4294967296

int power2(int exponent)
    result := 1
    for _ < exponent
        result *= 2
    return result

class Endpoint(int address, port := -1)

string endpoint_key(Endpoint value)
    return "{value.address}:" + (if value.port < 0 then "" else "{value.port}")

string pair_key(Endpoint first, Endpoint second)
    a := endpoint_key(first)
    b := endpoint_key(second)
    values := [a, b].sorted()
    return values[0] + "|" + values[1]

int index_value(map<string, int> indices, string key)
    match indices.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return -1

class Interval(int start, int length)
class PreviousAck(ack := -1, window := -1, number := -1, count := 0)
class DuplicateAck(int number, int count)
class StateChange(string state, int number)
class Event(int number, string side, string mark, int start, int length)

class Side(string name)
    isn := -1
    mss := -1
    wscale := -1
    base := -1
    expected := -1
    advanced_at := -1
    Interval[] intervals := []
    previous := PreviousAck()
    packets := 0
    payload := 0
    marks := array(4, fill = 0)

class Stream(int number, Endpoint client, Endpoint server, string state, int start, int first)
    history := [StateChange(state, first)]
    finish := start
    packets := 0
    bytes := 0
    syn := -1
    syn_ack := -1
    handshake_ack := -1
    Event[] events := []
    closer := ""
    final_ack := -1
    client_side := Side("client")
    server_side := Side("server")

    void .record_syn(dns.transport.network.dump.Packet packet, bool from_client)
        if from_client
            client_side.isn = packet.fields.number("tcp.seq_raw")
            client_side.mss = packet.fields.number("tcp.options.mss")
            client_side.wscale = packet.fields.number("tcp.options.wscale")
            syn = packet.number
        else
            server_side.isn = packet.fields.number("tcp.seq_raw")
            server_side.mss = packet.fields.number("tcp.options.mss")
            server_side.wscale = packet.fields.number("tcp.options.wscale")
            syn_ack = packet.number

class Tracker()
    Stream[] streams := []
    latest := map<string, int>()
    duplicates := map<int, DuplicateAck>()

    void .track(dns.transport.network.dump.Packet &packet)
        source := Endpoint(packet.fields.number("ip.src"), packet.fields.number("tcp.srcport"))
        destination := Endpoint(packet.fields.number("ip.dst"), packet.fields.number("tcp.dstport"))
        int seq := packet.fields.number("tcp.seq_raw")
        int ack := packet.fields.number("tcp.ack_raw")
        int window := packet.fields.number("tcp.window")
        int size := packet.fields.number("tcp.len")
        syn := packet.fields.number("tcp.flags.syn") == 1
        fin := packet.fields.number("tcp.flags.fin") == 1
        rst := packet.fields.number("tcp.flags.rst") == 1
        has_ack := packet.fields.number("tcp.flags.ack") == 1
        key := pair_key(source, destination)
        number := index_value(latest, key)
        if number < 0 or (streams[number].state == "CLOSED" or streams[number].state == "RESET") and syn and not has_ack
            state := if syn then (if has_ack then "SYN_RECEIVED" else "SYN_SENT") else "ESTABLISHED"
            client := if syn and has_ack then destination else source
            server := if syn and has_ack then source else destination
            number = int(#streams)
            created := Stream(number, client, server, state, packet.moment, packet.number)
            if syn
                .created.record_syn(packet, not has_ack)
            streams = streams.append(created)
            .latest.set(key, number)
        stream := streams[number]
        from_client := source == stream.client
        Side sender := if from_client then stream.client_side else stream.server_side
        Side other := if from_client then stream.server_side else stream.client_side
        .packet.fields.put_number("tcp.stream", number)
        if sender.base < 0
            sender.base = seq
        if has_ack and other.base < 0
            other.base = ack
        relative := (seq - sender.base + sequence_limit()) % sequence_limit()
        .packet.fields.put_number("tcp.seq", relative)
        if has_ack
            .packet.fields.put_number("tcp.ack", (ack - other.base + sequence_limit()) % sequence_limit())
        span := size + (if syn then 1 else 0) + (if fin then 1 else 0)
        mark := ""
        if span > 0
            if sender.expected >= 0 and relative != sender.expected
                if relative > sender.expected
                    mark = "lost_segment"
                else
                    repeated := false
                    for interval := sender.intervals[]
                        if interval.start == relative and interval.length == span
                            repeated = true
                    mark = if repeated then "retransmission" elif packet.moment - sender.advanced_at < 3000 then "out_of_order" else "retransmission"
            sender.intervals = sender.intervals.append(Interval(relative, span))
            if sender.expected < 0 or relative + span > sender.expected
                sender.expected = relative + span
                sender.advanced_at = packet.moment
        elif has_ack and not rst
            if sender.previous.ack >= 0 and sender.previous.ack == ack and sender.previous.window == window
                mark = "duplicate_ack"
                sender.previous.count += 1
                .duplicates.set(packet.number, DuplicateAck(sender.previous.number, sender.previous.count))
        if has_ack and mark != "duplicate_ack"
            sender.previous = PreviousAck(ack, window, packet.number)
        if mark != ""
            .packet.fields.put_presence("tcp.analysis." + mark)
            names := ["retransmission", "out_of_order", "lost_segment", "duplicate_ack"]
            for: index < 4
                if names[index] == mark
                    sender.marks[index] += 1
            stream.events = stream.events.append(Event(packet.number, sender.name, mark, relative, span))
        calculated := window
        if stream.client_side.wscale >= 0 and stream.server_side.wscale >= 0 and not syn
            calculated *= power2(sender.wscale)
        .packet.fields.put_number("tcp.window.calc", calculated)
        old := stream.state
        if rst
            if old != "CLOSED" and old != "RESET"
                stream.state = "RESET"
        elif old == "SYN_SENT" and sender.name == "server" and syn and has_ack and ack == (stream.client_side.isn + 1) % sequence_limit()
            stream.state = "SYN_RECEIVED"
            sender.isn = seq
            sender.mss = packet.fields.number("tcp.options.mss")
            sender.wscale = packet.fields.number("tcp.options.wscale")
            stream.syn_ack = packet.number
        elif old == "SYN_RECEIVED" and sender.name == "client" and has_ack and not syn and ack == (stream.server_side.isn + 1) % sequence_limit()
            stream.state = "ESTABLISHED"
            stream.handshake_ack = packet.number
        elif old == "ESTABLISHED" and fin
            stream.state = "FIN_WAIT"
            stream.closer = sender.name
        elif old == "FIN_WAIT" and fin and sender.name != stream.closer
            stream.state = "CLOSING"
            stream.final_ack = (seq + size + 1) % sequence_limit()
        elif old == "CLOSING" and sender.name == stream.closer and has_ack and ack == stream.final_ack
            stream.state = "CLOSED"
        if stream.state != old
            stream.history = stream.history.append(StateChange(stream.state, packet.number))
        sender.packets += 1
        sender.payload += size
        stream.packets += 1
        stream.bytes += packet.length
        stream.finish = packet.moment
        if from_client
            stream.client_side = sender
            stream.server_side = other
        else
            stream.client_side = other
            stream.server_side = sender
        streams[number] = stream

class Conversation(string kind, Endpoint source, Endpoint destination, int first, int start)
    finish := start
    packets_a_to_b := 0
    bytes_a_to_b := 0
    packets_b_to_a := 0
    bytes_b_to_a := 0

    int packets()
        return packets_a_to_b + packets_b_to_a

    int bytes()
        return bytes_a_to_b + bytes_b_to_a

class View(string kind, string key, Endpoint source, Endpoint destination)

bool conversation_before(Conversation first, Conversation second)
    if first.bytes() != second.bytes()
        return first.bytes() > second.bytes()
    if first.packets() != second.packets()
        return first.packets() > second.packets()
    if first.kind != second.kind
        a := if first.kind == "ipv4" then 0 elif first.kind == "tcp" then 1 else 2
        b := if second.kind == "ipv4" then 0 elif second.kind == "tcp" then 1 else 2
        return a < b
    return first.first < second.first

Conversation[] conversations(dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] packets)
    Conversation[] result := []
    map<string, int> by_key
    for packet := packets[]
        if not packet.fields.exists("ip.src")
            continue
        int a := packet.fields.number("ip.src")
        int b := packet.fields.number("ip.dst")
        source := Endpoint(a)
        destination := Endpoint(b)
        views := [View("ipv4", pair_key(source, destination), source, destination)]
        if packet.fields.exists("tcp.stream")
            views = views.append(View("tcp", "{packet.fields.number("tcp.stream")}", Endpoint(a, packet.fields.number("tcp.srcport")), Endpoint(b, packet.fields.number("tcp.dstport"))))
        if packet.fields.exists("udp.srcport")
            first := Endpoint(a, packet.fields.number("udp.srcport"))
            second := Endpoint(b, packet.fields.number("udp.dstport"))
            views = views.append(View("udp", pair_key(first, second), first, second))
        for view := views[]
            key := view.kind + "|" + view.key
            index := index_value(by_key, key)
            if index < 0
                index = int(#result)
                result = result.append(Conversation(view.kind, view.source, view.destination, packet.number, packet.moment))
                .by_key.set(key, index)
            if view.source == result[index].source
                result[index].packets_a_to_b += 1
                result[index].bytes_a_to_b += packet.length
            else
                result[index].packets_b_to_a += 1
                result[index].bytes_b_to_a += packet.length
            result[index].finish = packet.moment
    Conversation[] ordered := []
    for value := result[]
        position := int(#ordered)
        ordered = ordered.append(value)
        while position > 0 and conversation_before(value, ordered[position - 1])
            ordered[position] = ordered[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        ordered[position] = value
    return ordered

class EndpointTotals(int address)
    tx_packets := 0
    tx_bytes := 0
    rx_packets := 0
    rx_bytes := 0

    int packets()
        return tx_packets + rx_packets

    int bytes()
        return tx_bytes + rx_bytes

bool endpoint_before(EndpointTotals first, EndpointTotals second)
    if first.bytes() != second.bytes()
        return first.bytes() > second.bytes()
    if first.packets() != second.packets()
        return first.packets() > second.packets()
    return first.address < second.address

EndpointTotals[] endpoints(dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] packets)
    EndpointTotals[] result := []
    map<string, int> positions
    for packet := packets[]
        if not packet.fields.exists("ip.src")
            continue
        int[] addresses := [packet.fields.number("ip.src"), packet.fields.number("ip.dst")]
        for: direction < 2
            address := addresses[direction]
            index := index_value(positions, "{address}")
            if index < 0
                index = int(#result)
                result = result.append(EndpointTotals(address))
                .positions.set("{address}", index)
            if direction == 0
                result[index].tx_packets += 1
                result[index].tx_bytes += packet.length
            else
                result[index].rx_packets += 1
                result[index].rx_bytes += packet.length
    EndpointTotals[] ordered := []
    for value := result[]
        position := int(#ordered)
        ordered = ordered.append(value)
        while position > 0 and endpoint_before(value, ordered[position - 1])
            ordered[position] = ordered[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        ordered[position] = value
    return ordered

class Atom(number := 0, text := "", textual := false)

class Fields()
    entries := map<string, Atom[]>()

    Atom[] values(string name)
        match entries.get(name)
            Atom[] found
                return found
            none
                return []

    bool exists(string name)
        return entries.has(name)

    int number(string name, fallback := -1)
        Atom[] found := values(name)
        return if #found == 0 then fallback else found[0].number

    string text(string name)
        Atom[] found := values(name)
        return if #found == 0 then "" else found[0].text

    void .put_number(string name, int value)
        .entries.set(name, [Atom(value)])

    void .put_text(string name, string value)
        .entries.set(name, [Atom(0, value, true)])

    void .put_presence(string name)
        .entries.set(name, [Atom()])

    void .add_number(string name, int value)
        .entries.set(name, values(name).append(Atom(value)))

    void .add_text(string name, string value)
        .entries.set(name, values(name).append(Atom(0, value, true)))

    void .merge(Fields other)
        for name := other.entries.keys()[]
            .entries.set(name, other.values(name))

class Packet(int number, int moment, int length)
    int[] data := []
    dump_error := ""
    string[] layers := []
    fields := Fields()
    int[] remaining := []
    string[] answers := []

string[] read_lines(string path)
    string content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

int digit(string character, uppercase := false)
    digits := "0123456789abcdef"
    for: index < 16
        if digits[index] == character
            return index
    if uppercase
        capitals := "ABCDEF"
        for: index < 6
            if capitals[index] == character
                return index + 10
    return -1

bool hex_digits(string text, uppercase := false)
    if #text == 0
        return false
    for: index < int(#text)
        if digit(text[index], uppercase) < 0
            return false
    return true

int hex_value(string text)
    value := 0
    for: index < int(#text)
        value = value * 16 + digit(text[index], true)
    return value

string hexadecimal(int value, int width)
    if width <= 0 and value <= 0
        return "0"
    checked := nat(value)
    hex := checked.b16
    return if #hex < width then "0" * (width - #hex) + hex else hex

string ascii(int code)
    string characters := " !" + DQ + "#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{{|}}~"
    return characters[code - 32]

Packet[] read_capture(string path)
    Packet[] packets := []
    line_number := 0
    for line := read_lines(path)[]
        line_number += 1
        if line.starts_with("PACKET ")
            fields := line.split(" ")
            packets = packets.append(Packet(int(fields[1]), int(fields[2]), int(fields[3])))
            continue
        if line == ""
            continue
        current := int(#packets) - 1
        if packets[current].dump_error != ""
            continue
        valid := #line >= 8 and line[4:<6] == "  " and hex_digits(line[0:<4])
        string[] bytes := []
        if valid
            bytes = line[6:].split(" ")
            valid = 1 <= int(#bytes) <= 16
            for byte := bytes[]
                if #byte != 2 or not hex_digits(byte)
                    valid = false
        if not valid
            packets[current].dump_error = "dump: bad line {line_number}"
            continue
        offset := hex_value(line[0:<4])
        if offset != int(#packets[current].data)
            packets[current].dump_error = "dump: offset mismatch at line {line_number}"
            continue
        packets[current].data = packets[current].data.concat([for byte := bytes[] then hex_value(byte)])
    for: index < int(#packets)
        if packets[index].dump_error == "" and packets[index].length != int(#packets[index].data)
            packets[index].dump_error = "dump: length mismatch (header {packets[index].length}, data {#packets[index].data})"
    return packets

string[] hex_dump(int[] bytes)
    string[] lines := []
    for: offset < int(#bytes) step 16
        end := offset + 16
        if end > int(#bytes)
            end = int(#bytes)
        piece := bytes[offset:<end]
        hex := [for byte := piece[] then hexadecimal(byte, 2)].join(" ")
        characters := [for byte := piece[] then if 32 <= byte <= 126 then ascii(byte) else "."].join("")
        lines = lines.append(hexadecimal(offset, 4) + "  " + hex + " " * nat(47 - int(#hex)) + "  |" + characters + "|")
    return lines

public import dump = "./hexdump.qui"

class Layer()
    fields := dump.Fields()
    next_layer := ""
    int[] payload := []
    int[] remaining := []
    string[] answers := []

int integer(int[] data, int offset, int size)
    value := 0
    for: offset <= index < offset + size
        value = value * 256 + data[index]
    return value

int[] bytes(int value, int size)
    result := array(nat(size), fill = 0)
    remaining := value
    for: offset < size
        result[size - 1 - offset] = remaining % 256
        remaining /= 256
    return result

string checksum(int[] values)
    sum := 0
    for: index < int(#values) step 2
        low := if index + 1 < int(#values) then values[index + 1] else 0
        sum += values[index] * 256 + low
    while sum > 65535
        sum = sum % 65536 + sum / 65536
    return if sum == 65535 then "good" else "bad"

string mac(int value)
    return [for byte := bytes(value, 6)[] then dump.hexadecimal(byte, 2)].join(":")

string ipv4(int value)
    return [for byte := bytes(value, 4)[] then "{byte}"].join(".")

Layer | error ethernet(int[] data)
    if #data < 14
        return error("eth: truncated")
    layer := Layer()
    kind := integer(data, 12, 2)
    .layer.fields.put_number("eth.dst", integer(data, 0, 6))
    .layer.fields.put_number("eth.src", integer(data, 6, 6))
    .layer.fields.put_number("eth.type", kind)
    if kind == 2054 or kind == 2048
        layer.next_layer = if kind == 2054 then "arp" else "ip"
        layer.payload = data[14:]
    else
        layer.remaining = data[14:]
    return layer

Layer | error arp(int[] data)
    if #data < 28
        return error("arp: truncated")
    if integer(data, 0, 2) != 1 or integer(data, 2, 2) != 2048 or data[4] != 6 or data[5] != 4
        return error("arp: unsupported format")
    layer := Layer()
    .layer.fields.put_number("arp.opcode", integer(data, 6, 2))
    .layer.fields.put_number("arp.src.hw", integer(data, 8, 6))
    .layer.fields.put_number("arp.src.ip", integer(data, 14, 4))
    .layer.fields.put_number("arp.dst.hw", integer(data, 18, 6))
    .layer.fields.put_number("arp.dst.ip", integer(data, 24, 4))
    return layer

Layer | error ipv4_layer(int[] data)
    available := int(#data)
    if available < 20
        return error("ip: truncated header")
    version := data[0] / 16
    if version != 4
        return error("ip: bad version {version}")
    header := data[0] % 16 * 4
    if header < 20
        return error("ip: bad header length {header}")
    if available < header
        return error("ip: truncated header")
    total := integer(data, 2, 2)
    if total < header
        return error("ip: bad total length {total}")
    if total > available
        return error("ip: truncated (total length {total}, available {available})")
    layer := Layer()
    flags := integer(data, 6, 2)
    protocol := data[9]
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.hdr_len", header)
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.tos", data[1])
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.len", total)
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.id", integer(data, 4, 2))
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.flags.df", flags / 16384 % 2)
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.flags.mf", flags / 8192 % 2)
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.frag_offset", flags % 8192 * 8)
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.ttl", data[8])
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.proto", protocol)
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.checksum", integer(data, 10, 2))
    .layer.fields.put_text("ip.checksum.status", checksum(data[0:<header]))
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.src", integer(data, 12, 4))
    .layer.fields.put_number("ip.dst", integer(data, 16, 4))
    payload := data[header:<total]
    if flags / 8192 % 2 == 1 or flags % 8192 != 0
        .layer.fields.put_presence("ip.fragment")
        layer.remaining = payload
    elif protocol == 1 or protocol == 17 or protocol == 6
        layer.next_layer = if protocol == 1 then "icmp" elif protocol == 17 then "udp" else "tcp"
        layer.payload = payload
    else
        layer.remaining = payload
    return layer

string seconds(int value)
    return "{value / 1000000}.{value % 1000000:06.}"

string optional(int value)
    return if value < 0 then "-" else "{value}"

string notation(string kind, flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom value)
    if value.textual
        return value.text
    if kind == "hex2" or kind == "hex4"
        return "0x" + flow.dns.transport.network.dump.hexadecimal(value.number, if kind == "hex2" then 2 else 4)
    if kind == "ipv4"
        return flow.dns.transport.network.ipv4(value.number)
    if kind == "mac"
        return flow.dns.transport.network.mac(value.number)
    return "{value.number}"

string shown(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet packet, Schema schema, string name)
    return notation(schema.field_type(name), packet.fields.values(name)[0])

flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom[] field_values(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet packet, string name)
    if name == "eth.addr"
        return packet.fields.values("eth.dst").concat(packet.fields.values("eth.src"))
    if name == "ip.addr"
        return packet.fields.values("ip.src").concat(packet.fields.values("ip.dst"))
    if name == "tcp.port"
        return packet.fields.values("tcp.srcport").concat(packet.fields.values("tcp.dstport"))
    if name == "udp.port"
        return packet.fields.values("udp.srcport").concat(packet.fields.values("udp.dstport"))
    return packet.fields.values(name)

flow.dns.transport.network.Layer | error dissect_layer(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet packet, string name, int[] bytes)
    if name == "eth"
        return flow.dns.transport.network.ethernet(bytes)
    if name == "arp"
        return flow.dns.transport.network.arp(bytes)
    if name == "ip"
        return flow.dns.transport.network.ipv4_layer(bytes)
    if name == "icmp"
        return flow.dns.transport.icmp(bytes)
    if name == "udp"
        return flow.dns.transport.udp(bytes, packet.fields.number("ip.src"), packet.fields.number("ip.dst"))
    if name == "tcp"
        return flow.dns.transport.tcp(bytes, packet.fields.number("ip.src"), packet.fields.number("ip.dst"))
    return flow.dns.dissect(bytes)

void dissect(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet &packet, int base_time)
    string reason := packet.dump_error
    if reason == ""
        name := "eth"
        int[] payload := packet.data
        while true
            packet.layers = packet.layers.append(name)
            flow.dns.transport.network.Layer | error result := dissect_layer(packet, name, payload)
            match result
                error problem
                    reason = problem.message
                    break
                flow.dns.transport.network.Layer layer
                    .packet.fields.merge(layer.fields)
                    if name == "dns"
                        packet.answers = layer.answers
                    if layer.next_layer == ""
                        packet.remaining = layer.remaining
                        break
                    name = layer.next_layer
                    payload = layer.payload
    if reason == "" and #packet.remaining > 0
        packet.layers = packet.layers.append("data")
        .packet.fields.put_number("data.len", int(#packet.remaining))
    .packet.fields.put_number("frame.number", packet.number)
    .packet.fields.put_number("frame.time", packet.moment - base_time)
    .packet.fields.put_number("frame.len", packet.length)
    if #packet.layers > 0
        .packet.fields.put_text("frame.protocols", packet.layers.join(":"))
    if reason != ""
        .packet.fields.put_text("frame.malformed", reason)
        packet.remaining = []
    for name := ["ip", "icmp", "udp", "tcp"][]
        if packet.fields.text(name + ".checksum.status") == "bad"
            .packet.fields.put_presence("frame.bad_checksum")

string mark_text(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet packet, flow.Tracker tracker)
    if packet.fields.exists("tcp.analysis.duplicate_ack")
        match tracker.duplicates.get(packet.number)
            flow.DuplicateAck duplicate
                return "[TCP Dup ACK {duplicate.number}#{duplicate.count}] "
            none
                return ""
    marks := ["retransmission", "out_of_order", "lost_segment"]
    texts := ["[TCP Retransmission] ", "[TCP Out-Of-Order] ", "[TCP Previous segment not captured] "]
    for: index < 3
        if packet.fields.exists("tcp.analysis." + marks[index])
            return texts[index]
    return ""

string tcp_info(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet packet, flow.Tracker tracker)
    flag_names := ["FIN", "SYN", "RST", "PSH", "ACK", "URG", "ECE", "CWR"]
    string[] flags := []
    bit := 1
    for name := flag_names[]
        if packet.fields.number("tcp.flags") / bit % 2 == 1
            flags = flags.append(name)
        bit *= 2
    flag_text := if #flags == 0 then "<None>" else flags.join(", ")
    text := mark_text(packet, tracker) + "{packet.fields.number("tcp.srcport")} -> {packet.fields.number("tcp.dstport")} [{flag_text}] Seq={packet.fields.number("tcp.seq")}"
    if packet.fields.number("tcp.flags.ack") == 1
        text += " Ack={packet.fields.number("tcp.ack")}"
    text += " Win={packet.fields.number("tcp.window.calc")} Len={packet.fields.number("tcp.len")}"
    for value := packet.fields.values("tcp.option")[]
        string[] words := value.text.split(" ")
        if words[0] == "MSS"
            text += " MSS={words[1]}"
        elif words[0] == "WS"
            text += " WS={flow.power2(int(words[1]))}"
        elif words[0] == "SACK_PERM"
            text += " SACK_PERM"
        elif words[0] == "TS"
            text += " TSval={words[1]} TSecr={words[2]}"
    return text

string basic_info(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet packet, Schema schema, string protocol, flow.Tracker tracker)
    if packet.fields.exists("frame.malformed")
        return packet.fields.text("frame.malformed")
    if protocol == "ETH"
        return "EtherType " + shown(packet, schema, "eth.type")
    if protocol == "ARP"
        int opcode := packet.fields.number("arp.opcode")
        if opcode == 1
            return "Who has " + shown(packet, schema, "arp.dst.ip") + "? Tell " + shown(packet, schema, "arp.src.ip")
        if opcode == 2
            return shown(packet, schema, "arp.src.ip") + " is at " + shown(packet, schema, "arp.src.hw")
        return "Opcode {opcode}"
    if protocol == "IPv4"
        if not packet.fields.exists("ip.fragment")
            return "Protocol {packet.fields.number("ip.proto")}"
        text := "Fragment id=" + shown(packet, schema, "ip.id") + " off={packet.fields.number("ip.frag_offset")}"
        return text + (if packet.fields.number("ip.flags.mf") == 1 then " MF" else "")
    if protocol == "ICMP"
        int kind := packet.fields.number("icmp.type")
        if kind == 0 or kind == 8
            return (if kind == 8 then "Echo request" else "Echo reply") + " id={packet.fields.number("icmp.id")} seq={packet.fields.number("icmp.seq")}"
        return "Type {kind} code {packet.fields.number("icmp.code")}"
    if protocol == "UDP"
        return "{packet.fields.number("udp.srcport")} -> {packet.fields.number("udp.dstport")} Len={packet.fields.number("udp.length") - 8}"
    if protocol == "TCP"
        return tcp_info(packet, tracker)
    parts := [if packet.fields.number("dns.flags.response") == 1 then "Response" else "Query", shown(packet, schema, "dns.id")]
    int rcode := packet.fields.number("dns.flags.rcode")
    if rcode != 0
        parts = parts.append(flow.dns.rcode_name(rcode))
    flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom[] names := packet.fields.values("dns.qry.name")
    flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom[] kinds := packet.fields.values("dns.qry.type")
    for: index < int(#names)
        parts = parts.concat([flow.dns.type_name(kinds[index].number), names[index].text])
    return parts.concat(packet.answers).join(" ")

string summary(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet packet, Schema schema, flow.Tracker tracker)
    source := "-"
    destination := "-"
    if packet.fields.exists("ip.src")
        source = shown(packet, schema, "ip.src")
        destination = shown(packet, schema, "ip.dst")
    elif packet.fields.exists("eth.src")
        source = shown(packet, schema, "eth.src")
        destination = shown(packet, schema, "eth.dst")
    protocol := "DUMP"
    names := ["eth", "arp", "ip", "icmp", "udp", "tcp", "dns"]
    labels := ["ETH", "ARP", "IPv4", "ICMP", "UDP", "TCP", "DNS"]
    for layer := packet.layers[]
        for: index < 7
            if names[index] == layer
                protocol = labels[index]
    info := basic_info(packet, schema, protocol, tracker)
    if packet.fields.exists("tcp.options.malformed")
        info += " [bad TCP options]"
    checksum_names := ["ip", "icmp", "udp", "tcp"]
    checksum_labels := ["IPv4", "ICMP", "UDP", "TCP"]
    for: index < 4
        if packet.fields.text(checksum_names[index] + ".checksum.status") == "bad"
            info += " [bad {checksum_labels[index]} checksum]"
    return "{packet.number} " + seconds(packet.fields.number("frame.time")) + " {source} -> {destination} {protocol} {packet.length} {info}"

class Token(string kind, string text, int column)
class FilterNode(string kind, left := -1, right := -1, field := "", operation := "", flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom value := flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom())
class FilterTree(FilterNode[] nodes, int root)

bool comparison_operator(string text)
    return contains(["==", "!=", "<", ">", "<=", ">="], text)

Token[] | error tokenize(string expression)
    Token[] tokens := []
    index := 0
    word_characters := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._:"
    while index < int(#expression)
        character := expression[index]
        column := index + 1
        end := if index + 2 <= int(#expression) then index + 2 else int(#expression)
        pair := expression[index:<end]
        if character == " "
            index += 1
            continue
        string kind
        string text
        if #pair == 2 and (comparison_operator(pair) or pair == "&&" or pair == "||")
            kind = pair
            text = pair
            index += 2
        elif contains(["(", ")", "!", "<", ">"], character)
            kind = character
            text = character
            index += 1
        elif character == DQ
            last := index + 1
            while last < int(#expression) and expression[last] != DQ
                last += 1
            if last == int(#expression)
                return error("unterminated string at column {column}")
            kind = "string"
            text = expression[index:last]
            index = last + 1
        elif word_characters.contains(character)
            last := index
            while last < int(#expression) and word_characters.contains(expression[last])
                last += 1
            text = expression[index:<last]
            kind = if text == "and" then "&&" elif text == "or" then "||" elif text == "not" then "!" else "word"
            index = last
        else
            return error("invalid character '{character}' at column {column}")
        tokens = tokens.append(Token(kind, text, column))
    return tokens

bool decimal_digits(string text)
    if #text == 0
        return false
    for: index < int(#text)
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[index])
            return false
    return true

flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom | none converted(string kind, Token token)
    if kind == "string"
        return if token.kind == "string" then flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom(0, token.text[1:<int(#token.text) - 1], true) else none
    if token.kind != "word"
        return none
    text := token.text
    if kind == "integer" or kind == "hex2" or kind == "hex4"
        if 1 <= #text <= 15 and decimal_digits(text)
            return flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom(int(text))
        if text.starts_with("0x") and 3 <= #text <= 14 and flow.dns.transport.network.dump.hex_digits(text[2:], true)
            return flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.hex_value(text[2:]))
        return none
    parts := text.split(if kind == "ipv4" then "." else ":")
    if int(#parts) != (if kind == "ipv4" then 4 else 6)
        return none
    value := 0
    for part := parts[]
        int byte
        if kind == "ipv4"
            if not (1 <= #part <= 3) or not decimal_digits(part)
                return none
            byte = int(part)
            if byte > 255
                return none
        else
            if #part != 2 or not flow.dns.transport.network.dump.hex_digits(part, true)
                return none
            byte = flow.dns.transport.network.dump.hex_value(part)
        value = value * 256 + byte
    return flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom(value)

string unexpected_text(Token token)
    return "unexpected '{token.text}' at column {token.column}"

class Parser(Token[] tokens, Schema schema)
    position := 0
    FilterNode[] nodes := []

    string next_kind()
        return if position < int(#tokens) then tokens[position].kind else ""

    Token | error .take()
        if position >= int(#tokens)
            return error("unexpected end of filter")
        token := tokens[position]
        position += 1
        return token

    int .append_node(FilterNode node)
        index := int(#nodes)
        nodes = nodes.append(node)
        return index

    int | error .parse_test(string name)
        kind := schema.field_type(name)
        if kind == ""
            return error("unknown field {name}")
        if not comparison_operator(next_kind())
            return .append_node(FilterNode("exists", field = name))
        Token operator_token := try .take()
        operation := operator_token.kind
        if kind == "presence" or kind == "string" and operation != "==" and operation != "!="
            return error("operator {operation} not allowed for {name}")
        Token token := try .take()
        if token.kind != "word" and token.kind != "string"
            return error(unexpected_text(token))
        flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom | none value := converted(kind, token)
        match value
            none
                return error("invalid value {token.text} for {name}")
            flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom found
                return .append_node(FilterNode("compare", field = name, operation = operation, value = found))

    int | error .negation()
        if next_kind() == "!"
            Token skipped := try .take()
            int child := try .negation()
            return .append_node(FilterNode("not", child))
        Token token := try .take()
        if token.kind == "("
            int child := try .expression()
            Token closing := try .take()
            if closing.kind != ")"
                return error(unexpected_text(closing))
            return child
        if token.kind == "word"
            return try .parse_test(token.text)
        return error(unexpected_text(token))

    int | error .product()
        int node := try .negation()
        while next_kind() == "&&"
            Token skipped := try .take()
            int right := try .negation()
            node = .append_node(FilterNode("and", node, right))
        return node

    int | error .expression()
        int node := try .product()
        while next_kind() == "||"
            Token skipped := try .take()
            int right := try .product()
            node = .append_node(FilterNode("or", node, right))
        return node

    FilterTree | error .parse()
        int root := try .expression()
        if position < int(#tokens)
            return error(unexpected_text(tokens[position]))
        return FilterTree(nodes, root)

FilterTree | error parse_filter(string expression, Schema schema)
    tokens := try tokenize(expression)
    parser := Parser(tokens, schema)
    return try .parser.parse()

bool compare(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom first, string operation, flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Atom second)
    if first.textual
        return if operation == "==" then first.text == second.text else first.text != second.text
    if operation == "=="
        return first.number == second.number
    if operation == "<"
        return first.number < second.number
    if operation == ">"
        return first.number > second.number
    if operation == "<="
        return first.number <= second.number
    return first.number >= second.number

bool evaluate(FilterTree tree, int index, flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet packet)
    node := tree.nodes[index]
    if node.kind == "and"
        return evaluate(tree, node.left, packet) and evaluate(tree, node.right, packet)
    if node.kind == "or"
        return evaluate(tree, node.left, packet) or evaluate(tree, node.right, packet)
    if node.kind == "not"
        return not evaluate(tree, node.left, packet)
    if node.kind == "exists" and protocol_field(node.field)
        return contains(packet.layers, node.field)
    values := field_values(packet, node.field)
    if node.kind == "exists"
        return #values > 0
    if #values == 0
        return false
    if node.operation == "!="
        for value := values[]
            if value == node.value
                return false
        return true
    for value := values[]
        if compare(value, node.operation, node.value)
            return true
    return false

string[] details(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] packets, int number, Schema schema)
    if number < 1 or number > int(#packets)
        return ["packet {number} not found"]
    packet := packets[number - 1]
    lines := ["packet {number}"]
    for layer := ["frame"].concat(packet.layers)[]
        lines = lines.append(layer)
        for field := schema.fields[]
            if field.name.starts_with(layer + ".")
                for value := packet.fields.values(field.name)[]
                    lines = lines.append("  " + field.name + (if field.kind == "presence" then "" else " = " + notation(field.kind, value)))
        if layer == "data"
            lines = lines.concat([for line := flow.dns.transport.network.dump.hex_dump(packet.remaining)[] then "  " + line])
    return lines

class Transactions()
    flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] queries := []
    flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] responses := []
    int[] times := []
    unanswered := 0

Transactions dns_transactions(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] packets)
    result := Transactions()
    flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] pending := []
    for packet := packets[]
        if not packet.fields.exists("dns.id")
            continue
        if packet.fields.number("dns.flags.response") == 0
            result.queries = result.queries.append(packet)
            pending = pending.append(packet)
            continue
        result.responses = result.responses.append(packet)
        for: index < int(#pending)
            query := pending[index]
            if query.fields.number("dns.id") == packet.fields.number("dns.id") and query.fields.number("ip.src") == packet.fields.number("ip.dst") and query.fields.number("udp.srcport") == packet.fields.number("udp.dstport") and query.fields.number("ip.dst") == packet.fields.number("ip.src") and query.fields.number("udp.dstport") == packet.fields.number("udp.srcport")
                result.times = result.times.append(packet.moment - query.moment)
                pending = pending[0:<index].concat(pending[index + 1:])
                break
    result.unanswered = int(#pending)
    return result

int lookup_count(map<string, int> counts, string key)
    match counts.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

string[] mark_names()
    return ["retransmission", "out_of_order", "lost_segment", "duplicate_ack"]

string[] protocol_statistics(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] packets, Transactions transactions)
    bytes := 0
    for packet := packets[]
        bytes += packet.length
    lines := ["packets {#packets}", "bytes {bytes}", "duration " + seconds(packets[-1].moment - packets[0].moment), "hierarchy"]
    layers := ["eth", "arp", "ip", "icmp", "udp", "dns", "tcp"]
    indents := [0, 2, 2, 4, 4, 6, 4]
    for: index < 7
        count := 0
        total := 0
        for packet := packets[]
            if contains(packet.layers, layers[index])
                count += 1
                total += packet.length
        lines = lines.append(" " * nat(indents[index]) + "{layers[index]} {count} {total}")
    lines = lines.append("checksums")
    for layer := ["ip", "icmp", "udp", "tcp"][]
        good := 0
        bad := 0
        unchecked := 0
        for packet := packets[]
            string status := packet.fields.text(layer + ".checksum.status")
            if status == "good"
                good += 1
            elif status == "bad"
                bad += 1
            elif status == "none"
                unchecked += 1
        lines = lines.append("{layer} good {good} bad {bad}" + (if layer == "udp" then " none {unchecked}" else ""))
    bad_dump := 0
    for packet := packets[]
        if packet.dump_error != ""
            bad_dump += 1
    lines = lines.concat(["malformed", "dump {bad_dump}"])
    for layer := ["eth", "arp", "ip", "icmp", "udp", "tcp", "dns"][]
        count := 0
        for packet := packets[]
            if packet.dump_error == "" and packet.fields.exists("frame.malformed") and packet.layers[-1] == layer
                count += 1
        lines = lines.append("{layer} {count}")
    lines = lines.append("tcp analysis")
    for mark := mark_names()[]
        count := 0
        for packet := packets[]
            if packet.fields.exists("tcp.analysis." + mark)
                count += 1
        lines = lines.append("{mark} {count}")
    lines = lines.concat(["dns", "queries {#transactions.queries}", "responses {#transactions.responses}", "transactions {#transactions.times}", "unanswered {transactions.unanswered}"])
    if #transactions.times == 0
        lines = lines.append("response_time -")
    else
        minimum := transactions.times[0]
        maximum := minimum
        for value := transactions.times[]
            if value < minimum
                minimum = value
            if value > maximum
                maximum = value
        lines = lines.append("response_time min " + seconds(minimum) + " max " + seconds(maximum))
    rcodes := array(16, fill = 0)
    for packet := transactions.responses[]
        rcodes[packet.fields.number("dns.flags.rcode")] += 1
    for: code < 16
        if rcodes[code] > 0
            lines = lines.append("rcode " + flow.dns.rcode_name(code) + " {rcodes[code]}")
    map<string, int> counts
    for packet := transactions.queries[]
        for name := packet.fields.values("dns.qry.name")[]
            .counts.set(name.text, lookup_count(counts, name.text) + 1)
    string[] names := []
    for name := counts.keys().sorted()[]
        position := int(#names)
        names = names.append(name)
        while position > 0 and lookup_count(counts, name) > lookup_count(counts, names[position - 1])
            names[position] = names[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        names[position] = name
    lines = lines.append("names")
    for name := names[]
        lines = lines.append(name + " {lookup_count(counts, name)}")
    return lines

string endpoint_text(flow.Endpoint endpoint)
    return flow.dns.transport.network.ipv4(endpoint.address) + (if endpoint.port < 0 then "" else ":{endpoint.port}")

string[] conversation_lines(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] packets, int base_time)
    lines := ["type,endpoint_a,endpoint_b,packets,bytes,packets_a_to_b,bytes_a_to_b,packets_b_to_a,bytes_b_to_a,start,duration"]
    for row := flow.conversations(packets)[]
        string[] fields := [row.kind, endpoint_text(row.source), endpoint_text(row.destination), "{row.packets()}", "{row.bytes()}", "{row.packets_a_to_b}", "{row.bytes_a_to_b}", "{row.packets_b_to_a}", "{row.bytes_b_to_a}", seconds(row.start - base_time), seconds(row.finish - row.start)]
        lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
    return lines

string[] endpoint_lines(flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] packets)
    lines := ["address,packets,bytes,tx_packets,tx_bytes,rx_packets,rx_bytes"]
    for row := flow.endpoints(packets)[]
        lines = lines.append(flow.dns.transport.network.ipv4(row.address) + ",{row.packets()},{row.bytes()},{row.tx_packets},{row.tx_bytes},{row.rx_packets},{row.rx_bytes}")
    return lines

string side_line(flow.Side side)
    parts := ["{side.name} packets {side.packets} payload {side.payload}"]
    marks := mark_names()
    for: index < 4
        parts = parts.append("{marks[index]} {side.marks[index]}")
    return parts.join(" ")

string[] stream_lines(flow.Stream stream, flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] packets)
    rtt := "-"
    if stream.syn >= 0 and stream.handshake_ack >= 0
        rtt = seconds(packets[stream.handshake_ack - 1].moment - packets[stream.syn - 1].moment)
    history := [for change := stream.history[] then "{change.state} {change.number}"]
    lines := [
        "stream {stream.number} " + endpoint_text(stream.client) + " -> " + endpoint_text(stream.server),
        "packets {stream.packets} bytes {stream.bytes} start " + seconds(stream.start - packets[0].moment) + " duration " + seconds(stream.finish - stream.start),
        "states " + history.join(", "),
        "handshake syn " + optional(stream.syn) + " syn_ack " + optional(stream.syn_ack) + " ack " + optional(stream.handshake_ack) + " rtt " + rtt,
        "options client mss " + optional(stream.client_side.mss) + " wscale " + optional(stream.client_side.wscale) + " server mss " + optional(stream.server_side.mss) + " wscale " + optional(stream.server_side.wscale),
        side_line(stream.client_side),
        side_line(stream.server_side),
    ]
    for event := stream.events[]
        lines = lines.append("event {event.number} {event.side} {event.mark} seq {event.start} len {event.length}")
    return lines

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

schema := Schema()
flow.dns.transport.network.dump.Packet[] packets := flow.dns.transport.network.dump.read_capture("input/capture.txt")
int base_time := packets[0].moment
tracker := flow.Tracker()
for: index < int(#packets)
    dissect(&packets[index], base_time)
    if packets[index].fields.exists("tcp.srcport")
        .tracker.track(&packets[index])
summaries := [for packet := packets[] then summary(packet, schema, tracker)]
summary_output := summaries
string[] detail_output := []
detail_count := 0
for request := flow.dns.transport.network.dump.read_lines("input/filters.txt")[]
    if request.starts_with("FILTER ")
        string expression := request[7:]
        summary_output = summary_output.concat(["", "filter " + expression])
        FilterTree | error result := parse_filter(expression, schema)
        match result
            error problem
                summary_output = summary_output.append("error: " + problem.message)
            FilterTree tree
                count := 0
                for: index < int(#packets)
                    if evaluate(tree, tree.root, packets[index])
                        summary_output = summary_output.append(summaries[index])
                        count += 1
                summary_output = summary_output.append("matched {count} of {#packets}")
    elif request.starts_with("DETAIL ")
        number := int(request[7:])
        if detail_count > 0
            detail_output = detail_output.append("")
        detail_output = detail_output.concat(details(packets, number, schema))
        detail_count += 1
string[] streams_output := []
for: index < int(#tracker.streams)
    if index > 0
        streams_output = streams_output.append("")
    streams_output = streams_output.concat(stream_lines(tracker.streams[index], packets))
bool output_exists := file.is_directory("output")
if not output_exists
    file.mkdir("output")
write_lines("summary.txt", summary_output)
write_lines("details.txt", detail_output)
write_lines("conversations.csv", conversation_lines(packets, base_time))
write_lines("endpoints.csv", endpoint_lines(packets))
write_lines("protocol_stats.txt", protocol_statistics(packets, dns_transactions(packets)))
write_lines("tcp_streams.txt", streams_output)

public import network = "./link_network.qui"

int[] pseudo(int source, int destination, int protocol, int size)
    return network.bytes(source, 4).concat(network.bytes(destination, 4)).concat([0, protocol]).concat(network.bytes(size, 2))

network.Layer | error icmp(int[] data)
    if #data < 8
        return error("icmp: truncated")
    layer := network.Layer()
    kind := data[0]
    .layer.fields.put_number("icmp.type", kind)
    .layer.fields.put_number("icmp.code", data[1])
    .layer.fields.put_number("icmp.checksum", network.integer(data, 2, 2))
    .layer.fields.put_text("icmp.checksum.status", network.checksum(data))
    if kind == 0 or kind == 8
        .layer.fields.put_number("icmp.id", network.integer(data, 4, 2))
        .layer.fields.put_number("icmp.seq", network.integer(data, 6, 2))
    layer.remaining = data[8:]
    return layer

network.Layer | error udp(int[] data, int source, int destination)
    if #data < 8
        return error("udp: truncated")
    int size := network.integer(data, 4, 2)
    if size < 8 or size > int(#data)
        return error("udp: bad length {size}")
    layer := network.Layer()
    int first := network.integer(data, 0, 2)
    int second := network.integer(data, 2, 2)
    int checksum := network.integer(data, 6, 2)
    .layer.fields.put_number("udp.srcport", first)
    .layer.fields.put_number("udp.dstport", second)
    .layer.fields.put_number("udp.length", size)
    .layer.fields.put_number("udp.checksum", checksum)
    string status := if checksum == 0 then "none" else network.checksum(pseudo(source, destination, 17, size).concat(data[0:<size]))
    .layer.fields.put_text("udp.checksum.status", status)
    if first == 53 or second == 53
        layer.next_layer = "dns"
        layer.payload = data[8:<size]
    else
        layer.remaining = data[8:<size]
    return layer

bool valid_length(int kind, int size)
    if kind == 2
        return size == 4
    if kind == 3
        return size == 3
    if kind == 4
        return size == 2
    if kind == 5
        return size == 10 or size == 18 or size == 26 or size == 34
    if kind == 8
        return size == 10
    return true

void parse_options(int[] data, network.Layer &layer)
    index := 0
    while index < int(#data)
        kind := data[index]
        if kind == 0
            .layer.fields.add_text("tcp.option", "EOL")
            return
        if kind == 1
            .layer.fields.add_text("tcp.option", "NOP")
            index += 1
            continue
        size := if index + 1 < int(#data) then data[index + 1] else 0
        if size < 2 or index + size > int(#data) or not valid_length(kind, size)
            .layer.fields.put_presence("tcp.options.malformed")
            return
        body := data[index + 2:<index + size]
        text := "kind {kind} len {size}"
        if kind == 2
            int value := network.integer(body, 0, 2)
            .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.options.mss", value)
            text = "MSS {value}"
        elif kind == 3
            .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.options.wscale", body[0])
            text = "WS {body[0]}"
        elif kind == 4
            text = "SACK_PERM"
        elif kind == 5
            text = "SACK"
            for: offset < int(#body) step 8
                text += " {network.integer(body, offset, 4)}-{network.integer(body, offset + 4, 4)}"
        elif kind == 8
            text = "TS {network.integer(body, 0, 4)} {network.integer(body, 4, 4)}"
        .layer.fields.add_text("tcp.option", text)
        index += size

network.Layer | error tcp(int[] data, int source, int destination)
    if #data < 20
        return error("tcp: truncated header")
    header := data[12] / 16 * 4
    if header < 20
        return error("tcp: bad header length {header}")
    if header > int(#data)
        return error("tcp: truncated header")
    layer := network.Layer()
    flags := data[13]
    .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.srcport", network.integer(data, 0, 2))
    .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.dstport", network.integer(data, 2, 2))
    .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.seq_raw", network.integer(data, 4, 4))
    .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.hdr_len", header)
    .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.flags", flags)
    bit := 1
    for name := ["fin", "syn", "rst", "psh", "ack", "urg"][]
        .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.flags." + name, flags / bit % 2)
        bit *= 2
    .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.window", network.integer(data, 14, 2))
    .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.checksum", network.integer(data, 16, 2))
    .layer.fields.put_text("tcp.checksum.status", network.checksum(pseudo(source, destination, 6, int(#data)).concat(data)))
    .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.urgent", network.integer(data, 18, 2))
    .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.len", int(#data) - header)
    if flags / 16 % 2 == 1
        .layer.fields.put_number("tcp.ack_raw", network.integer(data, 8, 4))
    parse_options(data[20:<header], &layer)
    layer.remaining = data[header:]
    return layer
